author: sebastiandp
quote: Trash, absolute trash—the story is terrible. Jason is nothing more than Lucia’s slave; he doesn’t deserve to be called a fully-fledged person. Whatever she says, Jason just does it. Rockstar said this would be a Lucia with a strong personality who wouldn’t let anyone push her around, but all I see is that she’s only strong-willed toward Jason. When it comes to the other badasses,Lucia is as docile as a little chick.Translated with **** (free version)
